change_description: patience 50→100: exp_020 early-stopped at ep318 while NMAD was still decreasing (0.01909). Longer patience gives ReduceLROnPlateau more time to trigger LR reductions and find a deeper minimum now that warmup=50 lets the model train at full LR. Preserves all other exp_020 params (batch=256, mlp_dim=1024, 12 blocks, lr=1e-4, wd=5e-5).
